instructions: Evaluate the specific technical mechanism and whether a student or small team could prototype it using obtainable components.
Prioritize IoT, sensing, robotics, computer vision, edge AI, communications, embedded systems and useful software.
Generic mentions of AI, IoT or robotics alone are not sufficient for a high relevance score.
Adjacent or uncertain but potentially interesting inventions belong in patents-explore.
Do not infer grant, expiry, novelty or publication date from the day the search found the patent.
High relevance requires a specific technical mechanism, not merely mentions of familiar technologies.
Distinguish patent document content from cited-by lists, related patents, generic background and unrelated table rows.
Use patents-explore for adjacent or plausible but incompletely evidenced inventions; never claim legal status without verified metadata.
9-10 requires unusually strong fit and a concrete, accessible implementation; 7-8 strong fit; 4-6 exploratory; 0-3 unrelated.
